idea-plugin.name: cicy-code
idea-plugin.description:
Embed your cicy-code team workspace — multi-agent terminals, native files, artifacts — inside a JetBrains IDE tool window.

cicy-code is a SaaS. This plugin runs nothing locally; it renders a team you have already created/joined (configured by URL + token in Settings → Tools → cicy-code). Editing, LSP and debugging stay in the IDE; the cicy-code panel gives you the agent workspace beside it.
